one_loop_coefficients.key_result: C1=C2 at naive 1-loop; non-trivial fixed point from self-consistent RG (Verma 2004)
one_loop_coefficients.FNO_resolution: FNO learns effective action non-perturbatively, bypassing the C1=C2 degeneracy

self_consistent_RG.mechanism: Local mean field scales as k^{-1/3}, converting IK k^{-3/2} to K41 k^{-5/3}

FNO_RG_two_subrange_structure.crossover_mechanism: Local mean field B_loc(k) ~ k^{-1/3} becomes comparable to delta_b(k)
FNO_RG_two_subrange_structure.crossover_scale: Determined by B_0/delta_b ratio and cross-helicity sigma_c

with_dynamic_alignment.note: theta_a is scale-dependent alignment angle, learned by FNO

structure_function_predictions.FNO_RG_prediction: Two-subrange: zeta_p transitions from IK-like (p/4) at large scales to K41-like (p/3) at small scales, with SL intermittency corrections in each subrange

dynamic_scaling.critical_balance_condition: tau_A = tau_nl at RG fixed point
dynamic_scaling.FNO_RG_crossover: Scale-dependent transition from isotropic (IK) to anisotropic (GS95) scaling

magnetic_helicity_RG.forward_cascade: Magnetic helicity cascades forward in 3D MHD (unlike 2D inverse cascade)

effect_on_beta_function.zero_helicity: Standard MHD RG flow, fixed point gives k^{-5/3}
effect_on_beta_function.nonzero_helicity: Modified RG flow with helicity-dependent coupling
effect_on_beta_function.FNO_RG_prediction: Helicity introduces new marginal operator; FNO learns its scale dependence

helicity_barrier.discovery: McIntyre, Chen, Squire, Meyrand, Simon 2025, PhysRevX.15.031008
helicity_barrier.effect: Interrupts turbulent cascade at ion scales, redirects energy to ion cyclotron heating
helicity_barrier.FNO_RG_interpretation: Helicity barrier = new RG-relevant perturbation that destabilizes the standard fixed point when sigma_c > sigma_c^* and beta_i < beta_i^*
helicity_barrier.spectral_signature: Flattening/steepening of spectrum at transition range (ion scales)

spectral_scaling_helicity_observations.inertial_range: H_m(k) fluctuates randomly in sign (Matthaeus & Goldstein 1982)
spectral_scaling_helicity_observations.dissipation_range: Net right-handed helicity signature (Goldstein et al. 1994)
spectral_scaling_helicity_observations.Ulysses_sign_change: H_m changes sign at k ~ 2 AU^{-1} (Brandenburg et al. 2011)
spectral_scaling_helicity_observations.FNO_RG_prediction: H_m(k) ~ k^{-8/3} in the strong turbulence subrange, with sign reversal at subrange transition

imbalanced_MHD.FNO_RG_prediction: Separate RG flows for z+ and z- channels with sigma_c-dependent coupling

two_subrange_observations.Mondal_2024: Clear f^{-3/2} and f^{-5/3} subranges in fast wind at solar minimum (0.3-3.16 au)
two_subrange_observations.Wu_2025_AandA: Two subranges with zeta_2=1/2 and 2/3 in 103 Wind intervals
two_subrange_observations.D_Amicis_2025_SolarOrbiter: Two sub-ranges within inertial domain confirmed
two_subrange_observations.Chen_2020_PSP: Spectral index evolves from -3/2 to -5/3 from near-Sun to 1 au
two_subrange_observations.FNO_RG_prediction: FNO×RG naturally predicts the two-subrange structure as consequence of RG flow crossover

structure_function_observations.velocity_vs_magnetic: Magnetic spectra steeper than velocity (Podesta 2007, Salem 2009)
structure_function_observations.FNO_RG_prediction: Different anomalous dimensions for v and b fields explain v-b spectral difference

helicity_barrier_observations.Panchal_2025: Link between helicity barrier and ion cyclotron wave generation, ApJ 2025
helicity_barrier_observations.FNO_RG_prediction: Helicity barrier = RG-relevant perturbation destabilizing standard fixed point
